description: Translate one of the user's CVs into another language as a NEW, separate CV (the original stays), adapted to that language's CV format. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user applies in another country or language. Returns translatedCvId and its editor link.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

targetLocale.description: The language and CV format to translate into, e.g. "de-DE", "fr-FR".

name: translate_takemeup_cv
title: Translate CV → new CV (PRO)
